subject: test: isolate every C++ test from the real config dir (#3612)
summary: Automates isolation of all C++ unit tests from the developer's real ~/.config/lemonade directory by linking a throwaway-state library into every test binary via add_cpp_ci_test().
verdict_reason: A well-scoped test-infra change that eliminates a real developer-side bug, received substantive review, passes all CI checks, and introduces no user-visible surface.
